name: Fit Check and Chat – Market Drayton Library – 5 October
description: Free drop-in with The Cuddle Collective to check that a baby carrier works safely and comfortably for parent/carer and baby, plus an opportunity to meet other parents. Further sessions are listed for 7 December, 1 February and 5 April.
parking_transport: Public car park adjacent to Market Drayton Library.
age_guidance: Parents/carers with babies using a carrier

name: My Back Garden and Beyond
description: Photographer and naturalist Steve Dawes shares encounters with wildlife found in gardens and the wider countryside, illustrated with his nature photography.
accessibility: Wheelchair-accessible entrance explicitly confirmed by organiser.
parking_transport: Free car parking after 18:00. Disabled parking listed by organiser.

name: Shropshire Health Visiting Open Access Clinic – Bridgnorth – 6 October
description: Free, no-appointment health visiting drop-in offering health advice, information and support for parents/carers and their baby or child. Runs on the first two Tuesdays of each month at Bridgnorth Library, 13:30–16:00. Current confirmed dates include 6 and 13 October, 3 and 10 November, and 1 and 8 December 2026.
age_guidance: Parents/carers with babies or children; exact child age limit not stated

name: Song Sung Blue – Cardington Village Hall
description: Community cinema screening of the 12A musical drama Song Sung Blue through Arts Alive.

name: Ellesmere Library Rhymetime – 8 October
description: Free monthly song and rhyme session for babies aged 0–18 months. No need to book; just turn up. The current library listing identifies 8 October as the next future session.

description: Theatre on the Steps presents Blackadder Goes Forth from 8–17 October 2026. This record uses the first performance date; multiple performances are listed on the official booking page.

description: One-day beginner-to-intermediate painting workshop with David Bannister exploring coastal scenes including sea, beach, rocks, boats and figures. Participants need to bring the materials listed by the gallery.

description: Closed-road 10K starting and finishing in Oswestry town centre. The organiser confirms an 08:45 warm-up and 09:00 race start, with a 90-minute race cut-off. Hope House is the charity partner.
